### [`frdc cache clear`](@id ref-cache-clear)

Remove cached per-user Julia 1.14 LMDB object cache directories

| Option | Short | Type | Default | Choices | Description |
|--------|-------|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| `--format` | `-f` | `String` | `table` | `table`, `csv`, `json` | Output format |
| `--output` | `-o` | `String` | `""` | — | Write to file instead of stdout |

| Flag | Short | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| `--stale-only` | — | Remove only inactive build-stamp caches, keeping the current stamp |

**Output tables:** `cache_clear_summary` (Cache base directory, removed/kept stamp counts, and bytes freed)

### [`frdc cache info`](@id ref-cache-info)

Inspect per-user Julia 1.14 LMDB object cache location, status, and footprint

| Option | Short | Type | Default | Choices | Description |
|--------|-------|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| `--format` | `-f` | `String` | `table` | `table`, `csv`, `json` | Output format |
| `--output` | `-o` | `String` | `""` | — | Write to file instead of stdout |

**Output tables:** `cache_info` (Cache status, base/active directory, budget (FRDC_CACHE_MAX_MB), entry count, and total size); `cache_entries` (Per-build-stamp objcache directories and sizes (when entries exist))
